'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Scott Lingrell DS Prepared Defenses''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Username:''' advocate
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
